purpose_context: The events domain's Java services and contracts moved to spec-kitty-events (ADR 2026-10-29-1). This Mission pins the first service-v* release in core, points CI and the conformance tests at the pinned assets, removes core's frozen copies, and makes the release process verify the service pins (#6915 gaps 3 and 11).
purpose_tldr: Core consumes the released, pinned events read service instead of carrying the Java service and contracts in-tree.
